profile.headline: Engineering @ Ramp | Previously CTO @ Formidable
profile.summary: I’m a full-stack software engineer and open-source software maintainer with over 16 years of experience, building apps using web and native platform technologies. I’m a software engineer at Ramp.  Previously I was an engineer at Jolt AI and the CTO at Formidable, a global design, product, and engineering consultancy with a focus on open-source software. My background is leading engineering teams and organizations to build and ship performant, accessible, and scalable software applications.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Building out Ramp BIll Pay, an AI-powered accounts payable product that helps you process invoices, manage approvals, and make payments.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Jolt is an AI codegen and chat tool that is purpose-built for 100K to multi-million line codebases. I lead development of the client expereinces of Jolt which includes a web app, VSCode extension, JetBrains plugin, and an Electron-based desktop app. I created a unified client architecture using Node, SolidJS, Tailwind, and TypeScript that lets us deploy a unified codebase to each target with their own theming, UX, and native integrations. I also built out our marketing website using NextJS and Tailwind.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I led the engineering and product design delivery organization with a team size of over 80 across multiple disciplines. I worked jointly with Formidable's leadership team to ensure that our technical direction and structure of the engineering organization is aligned with the needs of our clients and strategic goals of Formidable. As a seasoned software engineer, I contributed to our open-source software and provide high-level support to our engineering teams. I worked with our technical partners to advance our engineering offerings and empower our teams to build software solutions that provide exceptional customer experiences for our clients. I helped lead the company through a successful acquisition by NearForm in 2023.

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: I oversee and mange client projects and a team of engineering managers with a focus on mobile and web applications. I work with our Business Development team on sales, staffing, and client relations. I partner with project Engineering Managers to ensure client and team health, delivery goals and objectives are met, and balance solutions based on business and team needs. In addition to my director responsibilities I maintain the Spectacle OSS project and help architect new client projects focused on front-end, iOS, and Android.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: I led a team of developers and mentor their technical and consulting skills in addition to IC work. Part of my duties involved annual reviews, bi–weekly 1:1s, and on–boarding new team members. I also helped with hiring and conducted interviews and served as hiring manager for React native and React web candidates.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I designed training curriculum and lead workshops for React native and React web for Sony and CascadiaJS. I have worked on several React Native and GraphQL apps for a large retail chain for next-generation checkout experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on a team that developed the web menu and ordering for Starbucks. I developed the React web UI and GraphQL mutations and queries for pricing and placing orders.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the mobile iOS and BackboneJS consumer banking applications in addition to the AngularJS control application.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the front-end development efforts of several lab projects for Marriott. Projects ranged from web applications to native iOS applications. The projects leveraged beacon technology, data-driven forms and geofencing. Technologies used were AngularJS, React, Redux and iOS native using Swift. I also created base infrastructure projects in React and iOS for rapid development of lab experiments.

positions.title: Team Lead, iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Team lead and senior developer for the Bespoke Offers iOS application for Barclaycard. Bespoke Offers is a daily deals and merchandising app for local retailers in the United Kingdom. It has been downloaded by over 300,000 users and has over 60,000 active users. My daily responsibilities include sprint planning, working with product owners on design and experience and development of the application’s services and architecture. I lead the initiative to refactor the codebase in Swift which has reduced overall lines of code, increased unit test coverage and accelerated delivery of features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I develop and design front-end web and iOS applications for desktop and mobile built with JavaScript, Swift, Objective-C and Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description: Senior developer and designer of the HuntForce iOS app. HuntForce is an all-in-one solution for sorting and managing hunting photos from your trail camera. HuntForce for iOS is a universal iPhone and iPad application written completely in Swift using the latest Swift frameworks for networking and image caching including AlamoFire and Haneke. It takes advantage of hardware-level animated graphics rendering using SpriteKit for engaging weather profile views. HuntForce for iOS also uses advanced core image video filtering for smooth filters and effects using the device’s GPU. The application has received over 300 downloads.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I assisted software development by co-designing the interface and unit testing for a slot-machine entertainment portal OS X application. I also performed the company’s transition to Macintosh-based computers.

projects.title: Onsite Health Diagnostics
projects.description: Part-time Ruby on Rails developer for Onsite Health Diagnostics for their internal health data visualization portal. The portal showed companies trends on health statistics and costs for their employees. Portions I developed include a filtered scheduling calendar for screening and graphs showing linear trends of employee conditions.

projects.title: KuBeat
projects.description: KuBeat was a concept web application for a Chinese-based musical social media site. The application connected fans with local artists and venues called live houses around Shanghai, Beijing and Hong Kong. I designed the user interface and wrote service-layer logic in Ruby on Rails. The web application had full unit testing coverage and was deployed on Amazon EC2 nodes.
